policies.name: audit_events
policies.with_check: (((action ~~ 'access.%'::text) AND ((actor ~~ 'member:%'::text) OR (actor ~~ 'scim:%'::text))) OR ((action = ANY (ARRAY['organization.updated'::text, 'account.created'::text, 'account.updated'::text, 'account.archived'::text, 'account.reactivated'::text, 'account.mapping_changed'::text, 'sso.connection_created'::text, 'sso.connection_updated'::text, 'sso.connection_disabled'::text, 'sso.connection_enabled'::text, 'sso.connection_tested'::text, 'scim.token_created'::text, 'scim.token_rotated'::text, 'scim.token_revoked'::text, 'provider.configured'::text, 'provider.enabled'::text, 'provider.disabled'::text, 'provider.approval_changed'::text, 'credential.set'::text, 'credential.rotated'::text, 'credential.revoked'::text, 'egress.levels_changed'::text, 'egress.step_up_completed'::text, 'egress.escalation_refused'::text])) AND (actor ~~ 'member:%'::text)) OR ((action = 'scim.request_refused'::text) AND (actor ~~ 'scim:%'::text)))

policies.name: external_identities
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM users u
  WHERE (u.id = external_identities.user_id)))

policies.name: memberships
policies.with_check:
((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'suspended'::text])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM users u
  WHERE ((u.id = memberships.user_id) AND (u.home_organization_id = memberships.organization_id)))))

policies.name: memberships
policies.with_check:
((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'suspended'::text])) OR ((status = 'removed'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM directory_identities d
  WHERE ((d.organization_id = memberships.organization_id) AND (d.membership_id = memberships.id) AND (d.managed_by = 'identity_provider'::text))))))

policies.name: oidc_login_attempts
policies.using: (((purpose = 'sign_in'::text) AND (consumed_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (expires_at <= now()))

policies.name: source_sync_runs
policies.using:
((started_at < (now() - '180 days'::interval)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM source_sync_runs newer
  WHERE ((newer.organization_id = source_sync_runs.organization_id) AND (newer.source_id = source_sync_runs.source_id) AND (newer.started_at > source_sync_runs.started_at)))))

policies.name: users
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM memberships m
  WHERE (m.user_id = users.id)))
